signal: Schoox won two 2026 Lighthouse Tech Awards for Best Advance in Practical AI and Best Frontline Focused Solution for its workforce learning platform.

email.body1:
Scott, saw Schoox pick up two 2026 Lighthouse Tech Awards, including Best Advance in Practical AI.

Award recognition usually surfaces more in-market enterprise accounts than a team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Schoox off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for Schoox.

When awards drive a wave of interest, most enterprise teams can't tell how many of those leads become booked meetings before the trail goes cold. The gap surfaces late, and recovering a quarter is far harder than getting ahead of it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise book needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for Schoox.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Schoox's reply rate likely compares to peer learning-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Scott, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Awards season keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise learning motion? I'll tailor it to Schoox either way.
